FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something strange. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But we are in the Middle Ages.

KING
(nodding)
Exactly. We must break free from the shackles of tradition. We must... (he gestures grandly)...we must vaporwave our aesthetic.

ZORVATH
(confused)
Vaporwave, Your Majesty? But that's a... a... (he searches for the right words)...a genre of music.

KING
(determined)
Yes, yes, yes. Music. But also... (he snaps his fingers)...also fashion. Also... (he thinks for a moment)...also architecture.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king, resplendent in a shimmering silver jumpsuit, sits on his throne, surrounded by his courtiers. They are all dressed in the latest vaporwave fashion, with neon-colored wigs, oversized sunglasses, and plenty of pastel-colored clothing.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We must... (he gestures to a nearby servant)...we must add more... more... (he searches for the right words)...more synths to our architecture.

SERVANT
(nervously)
Yes, Your Majesty. I'll see to it immediately.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The buildings are now covered in neon lights, and the streets are filled with hoverbikes and flying contraptions. The king, still wearing his silver jumpsuit, rides a hoverbike through the streets, surrounded by his courtiers.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We must... (he gestures to a nearby castle)...we must vaporwave our castles. Make them... (he searches for the right words)...more... more... (he snaps his fingers)...more futuristic.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king, now surrounded by his courtiers, is addressing the entire kingdom.

KING
(to the kingdom)
We are no longer just a medieval kingdom. We are... (he gestures grandly)...we are a kingdom of the future. A kingdom of... (he searches for the right words)...of vaporwave.

The courtiers all nod in agreement, and the kingdom erupts in cheers.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a fully-fledged vaporwave utopia. The king, still wearing his silver jumpsuit, rides a hoverbike through the streets, surrounded by his courtiers.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We must... (he gestures to a nearby servant)...we must add more... more... (he searches for the right words)...more synths to our kingdom.

SERVANT
(nervously)
Yes, Your Majesty. I'll see to it immediately.

The camera zooms out, showing the entire kingdom in all its vaporwave glory.

KING
(to the camera)
We are the future. We are... (he searches for the right words)...we are vaporwave.

FADE TO BLACK.
